kind: conservative analytical bounds, not a warmup failure counter
scope: All binary PC/address inputs, finite histories from zero h/c, at most32 decoder iterations
assumptions: C++ default round-to-nearest float32 and stable sign-split sigmoid; CPU runtime uses tanh projection and bounded sigmoid/tanh LSTM/GRU.
Encoder hidden absolute value <=1. Cell update magnitude grows by at most1 per completion in exact arithmetic; float32 remains finite for the declared finite warmup/ROI.
Decoder state is a convex sigmoid blend of tanh candidate and previous hidden; bound2 includes ample float32 rounding margin over <=32 decoder steps.
Each head coordinate/logmean is bounded by abs(bias)+sum(abs(weight))*state_bound; 0.01 percent plus1e-4 padding covers the small8-term float32 sums.
limitation: The generic engine clears numerical_failures at ROI reset; this independent bound establishes that the actual three balanced checkpoints in this supplement cannot reach count/delta overflow or nonfinite arithmetic under this input/state domain. It does not certify arbitrary future model files.
